payout_quote: Listing on Swimply is completely free, we only make money after you do. Swimply works on a commission basis and takes 15-25% of the booking price to support the marketing, app infrastructure, Host Guarantee, Host Support and more.
steps: Create a Swimply host account (US, Canada, or Australia; 18+).
Complete the 3-step listing: describe your pool/space with photos, set your rules and availability, and name your own hourly price.
Accept bookings; guests are charged upfront via Swimply's Stripe-powered payment system.
Your payout is directly deposited after each booking, minus Swimply's 15-25% commission.
catches: Swimply takes a 15-25% commission on every booking (host-side), and guests pay an additional ~10% service fee, which can suppress your effective rate vs. listing price.

Earnings are entirely variable: you set the hourly price but bookings depend on location, pool quality, weather, and season; Swimply's own averages ('$3,500/mo' estimator, 'Portland pool owners average $10-20k this Summer') are marketing illustrations, not guarantees - most hosts earn far less.
Available only in the US, Canada, and Australia; some cities/neighborhoods have little or no demand.

Strangers visit your home: you control house rules and guest access, but liability, neighbor/HOA complaints, and property damage risk are real; Swimply's $1M liability + $10k property protection applies per-occurrence with terms and exclusions - read them.
Pool maintenance costs (chemicals, cleaning, repairs, insurance) come out of your pocket and can be substantial.
Rental income is taxable; check local short-term-rental / pool-operation regulations and HOA rules before listing.
Seasonal: demand collapses outside swim season in most climates.
biggest_catch: Swimply keeps 15-25% of every booking and there is no guaranteed income: guests book only if your pool, location, and price attract them; Swimply's earnings illustrations are marketing, most hosts earn far less, and ongoing pool upkeep eats into whatever you make.
eligibility: US, Canada, or Australia only. Must be 18+ and own or control a pool (or bookable outdoor space - sport courts, saunas, home gyms). You must set house rules, availability, and pricing; verify compliance with local regulations, HOA, and landlord rules.
timing: Listing setup is a short online flow (describe space, photos, rules, price); payouts are direct-deposited after each completed booking. First booking depends on demand and can take weeks; bookings are seasonal.
